notes: Yamaha DXR/DXS Owner's Manual (C0; copyright 2011–2013), Specifications table, exact DXS12 column: powered subwoofer, band-pass type; frequency range 47–160 Hz (-10 dB); one 12-inch cone with a 2.5-inch voice coil; Class-D internal amplifier rated 950 W dynamic and 600 W continuous; maximum SPL 131 dB peak. The primary response bounds retain the published -10 dB context. The 600 W continuous figure is internal amplifier output, not passive speaker power handling; the separate 950 W dynamic rating is not substituted. Peak SPL and the +1 dBu line-input sensitivity are not acoustic sensitivity, and the 10 kΩ figure is input impedance rather than loudspeaker load impedance, so those fields remain N/A. No response curve, resonance, or directivity data is published in this table. Source: https://data.yamaha.com/files/download/other_assets/3/325553/dxr-dxs_en_om_c0.pdf.
